MYTROS.ReconFrozen: Death Toll is frozen — Kentimane has been defeated.
MYTROS.NoBattleScene: Please navigate to the designated Battlemap Scene to view sections.
MYTROS.ObjectiveHint: Destroying this objective immediately grants Sydon Miracle points and permanently increases civilian deaths each round.
MYTROS.AdvanceRoundTooltip: End this round and begin the next
MYTROS.AdjacencyHint: Define which sections are adjacent for Warden (+2 Clash) and Rallier (+2 Hope) tag effects.
MYTROS.BenefitDefensive: Defensive Footing (+1d4 to Clash, +2 to own Recovery)
MYTROS.BenefitSeizedInit: Seized Initiative (+1d2 injuries to enemy if you win)
MYTROS.TiebreakerHint: Keep rolling until one side wins.
MYTROS.RecoveryHint: Winner: success=no injury, fail=+1 injury. Loser: success=+1 injury, fail=+2 injuries. Nat 1 always fails.
MYTROS.HopeHint: DC 12. Winner: success=+2, fail=+1 Morale. Loser: success=−1, fail=−2 Morale. Cap 10.
MYTROS.SalvageTacticalInsight: Tactical Insight (+1d2 to Wit rolls next round)
MYTROS.CommanderHint: Won=6%, Lost=12%, Lost by 3+=20%. Subtract Morale for final target. Min 1%.
MYTROS.CommitHint: All rolls complete. Write injuries, morale, and commander changes to the actor sheets.
MYTROS.BattleCompleteHint: All changes have been saved. Close this window when ready.
MYTROS.NoSupportManage: No support units found. Create one or tag an existing actor.
MYTROS.DeleteLegionConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete legion
MYTROS.DeleteCommanderConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete commander
MYTROS.NoLegionsManage: No legions found. Create one or import from CSV.
MYTROS.NoCommandersManage: No commanders found. Create one or import from CSV.
MYTROS.SettingSectionPrefixHint: Regions whose names start with this prefix are treated as battle sections.
MYTROS.SettingDestroyThresholdHint: Number of injuries at which a legion is destroyed (Bulwark adds +1).
MYTROS.SettingHopeDCHint: DC for the Hope aftermath roll.
MYTROS.SettingSalvageDCHint: DC for the Salvage aftermath roll.
MYTROS.SettingAlliedMiraclePoolHint: Starting allied miracle points for a new battle.
MYTROS.SettingSydonMiraclePoolHint: Starting sydon miracle points for a new battle.
MYTROS.SettingDeathMultAlliedHint: Multiplier for civilian deaths when allied wins an engagement (1d4 × this value).
MYTROS.SettingDeathMultSydonHint: Multiplier for civilian deaths when Sydon wins or pillages (1d6 × this value).
MYTROS.SettingDeathMultObjectiveHint: Multiplier for ongoing deaths per destroyed objective per round (1d4 × this value).
MYTROS.SettingCmdrCasualtyWinHint: Base percentage chance of commander death after winning a battle.
MYTROS.SettingCmdrCasualtyLoseHint: Base percentage chance of commander death after losing a battle.
MYTROS.SettingCmdrCasualtyCrushHint: Base percentage chance of commander death after losing by 3+ on the counter.
MYTROS.SetupRulesHint: Configure these values in Module Settings.
MYTROS.ResetBattleConfirm: This will reset all battle state to initial values: round, phase, miracles, death toll, injuries, morale, rout/destroy flags, region control, completed events and objectives. This cannot be undone. Are you sure?
MYTROS.TagDesc.Fanatic: +2 to Charge and Clash rolls. Disadvantage on Recovery checks.
MYTROS.TagDesc.Zealot: +2 to all battle rolls (Maneuver, Charge, Clash) while Morale ≥ 7.
MYTROS.TagDesc.Warden: +2 to Clash. Adjacent allied legions gain +2 to Recovery checks.
MYTROS.TagDesc.Vanguard: May move 3 sections. Gains Advantage on Charge if it moves 3 sections this round.
MYTROS.TagDesc.Headhunter: Enemy suffers Disadvantage on Clash. +5% to enemy commander death chance.
MYTROS.TagDesc.Mage: Enemy suffers −1 to all battle rolls and Disadvantage on Recovery.
MYTROS.TagDesc.Engineer: Enemy legions fighting in this legion's fortified sections suffer −2 to all battle rolls.
MYTROS.TagDesc.SiegeBreaker: Nullifies enemy fortification bonuses and disables opposing Engineer tags.
MYTROS.TagDesc.Medic: Advantage on Recovery checks. On a win + success, removes 1 existing injury.
MYTROS.TagDesc.Rallier: +3 to Hope checks. Adjacent allied legions gain +2 to Hope checks.
MYTROS.TagDesc.Terrorizer: Enemy suffers Disadvantage on Hope checks after battle.
MYTROS.TagDesc.Brutal: Enemy makes Recovery with Disadvantage on a loss. If enemy has ≥4 injuries after the check, takes 1 more.
MYTROS.TagDesc.Veteran: Treat any natural d20 roll of 1–4 as a 5 before modifiers.
MYTROS.TagDesc.DivineBlood: Auto-rerolls first failed aftermath check, takes the better result. −5% commander death chance.
MYTROS.TagDesc.UnbreakablePact: Commander Casualty checks rolled twice; take the lower (better) result.
MYTROS.TagDesc.Relentless: Legion Morale can never fall below 2.
MYTROS.ReconIntelTwo: Learn the destination of 2 enemy legions.
MYTROS.ReconIntelHalf: Learn the destinations of up to half the enemy legions (rounded up).
MYTROS.ReconIntelBonus: Learn all enemy destinations. +1 to all allied Maneuver rolls this round!
MYTROS.CasualtiesIntro: The war takes its toll across the city...
MYTROS.CasualtiesObjective: Destroyed Strategic Objectives under Sydon Control
MYTROS.RoundAdvanceNotification: Round {round} begins. {deaths} civilian deaths this past round.
MYTROS.SupportExisting: Existing actor "{name}" designated as a Support Unit.
MYTROS.TagsLegendHint: Reference for all commander tag effects in battle.
